en.settingsRow.title: Dynamic workflows
en.settingsRow.description: Let the model orchestrate many subagents working in parallel, so it can take on complex tasks and deliver polished results.
en.settingsRow.option.disabled.description: Turn dynamic workflows off. The model cannot start new workflows; saved workflows and past runs stay viewable.
en.settingsRow.option.onDemand.description: The model starts a new workflow only when you type /workflow.
en.settingsRow.option.alwaysOn.description: Besides /workflow, the model can also start a workflow from your request on its own.
en.settingsRow.saveError: Could not save the dynamic workflow setting.
en.settingsRow.loadError: Could not read the current setting.
en.settingsRow.restart: Takes effect after the app restarts.
en.settingsRow.readOnly: This setting cannot be changed in the current environment.

zh.settingsRow.title: 动态工作流
zh.settingsRow.description: 让模型用脚本编排大量子代理并行工作，处理复杂任务、交付专业结果。
zh.settingsRow.option.disabled.description: 关闭动态工作流。模型不能启动新的工作流，已保存的工作流和运行记录仍可查看。
zh.settingsRow.option.onDemand.description: 只有输入 /workflow 命令才会启动新的工作流。
zh.settingsRow.option.alwaysOn.description: 除了 /workflow 命令，模型也会根据你的请求主动启动工作流。
zh.settingsRow.saveError: 保存动态工作流设置失败。
zh.settingsRow.readOnly: 当前环境不允许修改这个设置。
